##############
 Contributing
##############

Thanks for taking the time to contribute to docstrfmt!

The full contributing guide — development setup, testing, code style, and PR
guidelines — lives with the rest of the documentation:

- `Contributing (rendered) <https://docstrfmt.readthedocs.io/en/latest/package_info/contributing.html>`_
- Source: ``docs/package_info/contributing.rst``

Please read it before opening a pull request.

If you're reporting a bug or asking a question, use the `issue tracker
<https://github.com/LilSpazJoekp/docstrfmt/issues>`_ instead.
